extraction_notes: Maximum ratings at Ta=25 degC unless otherwise specified: VRRM=30 V, VRMS=21 V, VDC=30 V, IF(AV)=0.2 A, IFRM=0.3 A, IFSM=0.6 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine wave, PD=0.5 W; Tj and TSTG ranges are -55 to +150 degC; p. 1 Maximum Ratings.
Forward-voltage table provides maximum values at IF=0.1 mA, 1.0 mA, 10 mA, 30 mA, and 100 mA; no minimum or typical values were published.
Reverse-current table provides a maximum of 2.0 uA at VR=25 V and Ta=25 degC; capacitance table provides a maximum of 10 pF at VR=1.0 V and f=1 MHz; p. 2 Electrical Characteristics.
No reverse-recovery time or breakdown characteristic is published; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current are null.
Curves were digitized from the supplied p. 2 plots without interpolation between plotted samples; digitized curve values are approximate readings from the graph axes.
